provenance: Original fictional line-addressable expansion; KA-0 index cards and relevance labels unchanged.

text.en:
Fictional Beijing lodging policy; amounts are per room per night.
Effective from 2025-01-01 through 2025-12-31.
The lodging limit is 600 yuan.
text.zh-hans:
虚构北京差旅住宿制度；金额单位为元/间夜。
适用于 2025-01-01 至 2025-12-31。
住宿限额为 600 元。

text.en:
Fictional Beijing lodging policy; amounts are per room per night.
Effective from 2026-01-01; replaces travel-v1.

虚构北京差旅住宿制度；金额单位为元/间夜。

text.en:
Fictional Beijing rail FAQ.
Train guidance does not state a lodging limit.
text.zh-hans:
虚构北京铁路常见问题。
乘车说明没有规定住宿限额。

text.en:
Fictional order FAQ: processing is a possible order status.
This FAQ is not a live lookup of A-104.
text.zh-hans:
虚构订单常见问题：处理中是订单可能出现的状态。

text.en:
Cancellation of a fictional order requires approval.
Reading this policy does not grant approval or execute cancellation.
text.zh-hans:
取消虚构订单需要审批。
读到这条规则不等于获得批准，也不会执行取消操作。
